hypothesis: CIFAR-100 V3 already saturates per-class source coverage, but class-wise source usage remains substantially less uniform than on CIFAR-10. A degree-preserving final-layer refinement toward underused sources can improve accuracy without changing V3, gates, parameters, routing storage, or inference cost.

method.name: class-conditional coverage head
method.relationship_to_v3: separate final-layer strategy constructed from the exact frozen V3 final-layer base

controls.reuse_policy: Do not rerun completed experiments. Reuse the exact paired 20K random and frozen V3 artifacts from table4_cifar100_deep_selection.

promotion.rule: Promote only if both paired three-seed mean thresholds are met. Otherwise stop before full schedule, transfer, convolutional use, or held-out test.
promotion.full_schedule_if_promoted: Reuse the 6x64K scalability paper schedule and evaluate held-out test exactly once after checkpoints are frozen.
